name: Suzuki Takumi
source:
An acquaintance of Wakaba's from her school days.
He used to bully Wakaba and is an existence in her memory that she would like to erase.
He has been employed by a major company and has risen through the ranks, which is hard to believe for someone in his second year at the company.
He tries to stay out of trouble at work, but it is rumored that his cock is so big that it makes all of his girlfriends faint.
